_: Kill-check for the gate's step environment. `scripts/gate.mjs` decides what a run does from four ASCEND_ variables in `process.env`, the hook that starts it exports two, and every process the runner spawns inherited them -- so a `pnpm test` started by a pre-push gate ran the runner's own control-flow tests under the gate's own mode, 14 of those 32 went red, and every push was blocked from any tree. Four mutants, in the order the decision is made: the call site, the strip, a name missing from the list, and a name that has outlived the read it was added for. Every killer below was FOUND, not guessed: each mutant was planted in the working tree and scripts/gate-env.test.ts run with --reporter=json, and the failing names were read off assertionResults. Measured 2026-10-14, one mutant per run, each restore verified by sha256. M2 and M3 are killed by the same pair deliberately -- a strip that does not happen and a strip that skips one variable are the same leak at two sizes.
